mintAuthority.summary: sfrxUSD is native on Ethereum and Fraxtal, with the canonical deployments controlled by the Frax Safe. The live Ethereum implementation exposes authorized minter_mint issuance with no token-level numeric amount cap; the Ethereum lockbox is bridge machinery assessed separately under Bridge Risk, while the Fraxtal owner/control authority remains ABI-limited in this review.

controls.label: Ethereum sfrxUSD native authorized minter Safe
controls.capDescription: The live Ethereum sfrxUSD implementation exposes minter_mint(address,uint256) without a token-level numeric amount cap; the authorized minter set and Safe/lockbox accounting are the practical controls.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771146 (2026-08-16 00:14:35 UTC), the sfrxUSD proxy resolved to implementation 0xaad4a1d92053a62ce7a787641d8b4e5883e96700 and timelockAddress() returned 0x4b45d73b83686e69d08e61105fdb7f7b51f41bc1. minters_array(0) and minters_array(1) returned the Frax Safe and Ethereum lockbox 0x7311cea93ccf5f4f7b789ee31eba5d9b9290e126. Sourcify verifies minter_mint(address,uint256) and minter_burn_from(address,uint256) as minters-mapping gated, with no numeric amount cap in the reviewed implementation; ordinary ERC-4626 deposit, mint, withdraw, and redeem paths are disabled in the live implementation.

controls.label: Inherited Frax Comptroller Safe / Ethereum wrapper ProxyAdmin
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25771146, 0xB1748C79709f4Ba2Dd82834B8c82D4a505003f27 was not in the live sfrxUSD minters set. It remains the inherited frxUSD/Comptroller Safe and the current owner of the Ethereum sfrxUSD lockbox; the Ethereum wrapper proxy upgrade path also resolves through ProxyAdmin 0xea0a6ec8114a0af6cf74ca0036ab31d892df13cb and this Safe. Its sfrxUSD capability is therefore upgrade-only and inherited/bridge-administration related, not direct minter_mint authority.

controls.label: Frax Safe Fraxtal native sfrxUSD owner/control
controls.capDescription: The Fraxtal owner/control authority is verified, but the implementation-specific minter ABI and numeric amount bounds were not independently enumerated in this pass.
controls.evidence: At Fraxtal block 40057487 (2026-08-16 00:14:45 UTC), the native sfrxUSD address 0xfc00000000000000000000000000000000000008 resolved to implementation 0xba026e978eb1b11d72adabf33b7cf6f3e321ca83, EIP-1967 admin 0xfc0000000000000000000000000000000000000a, and owner 0x4b45d73b83686e69d08e61105fdb7f7b51f41bc1. The implementation-specific minter ABI was not independently enumerated, so no separate Fraxtal minter list or direct amount bound is inferred beyond this current owner/control evidence.

review.evidence: sfrxUSD has two reviewed native deployments: the Ethereum proxy and the Fraxtal native address. At Ethereum block 25771146, the live implementation exposes authorized minter_mint issuance through the 0x4b45... Safe and the Ethereum lockbox; minter_mint has no token-level numeric amount cap, while the lockbox is bridge machinery assessed separately under Bridge Risk. At Fraxtal block 40057487, the same Safe is the native deployment owner, but the implementation-specific minter ABI was not independently enumerated. The inherited 0xB174... Comptroller Safe is not a current Ethereum sfrxUSD minter; it remains relevant to the underlying frxUSD and the Ethereum lockbox owner/ProxyAdmin path. There is no separate sfrxUSD supply-versus-reserve attestation cadence and no financial regulator supervises Frax.
